description: This source file defines a React hook and a utility function for managing progressive, batched execution of work items in a non-blocking manner, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback. It provides mechanisms to start, monitor, and cancel progressive processing, primarily aimed at UI responsiveness and batch updates in React applications.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages the progressive, batched processing of items. It handles scheduling, applying batches, tracking progress, and providing start/cancel controls.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps around createProgressiveExpandController to manage UI state (running status, progress, counts) and provide start/cancel functions for progressive batch processing in React components.
